title: Web Search tool
description:
Create at least 3 versions of web search tools for the agent (for 3 different standard providers).
Include EXA as a tool.
Make sure to update the README.md

features.title: Create Foundation for Web Search Tools
features.description: Create a new file `src/tools/webSearchTools.ts`. This file will define a generic interface for web search tools and a factory function `createWebSearchTools`. It will also handle reading required API keys (e.g., `EXA_API_KEY`, `TAVILY_API_KEY`, `SERPAPI_API_KEY`) from environment variables.

features.title: Implement EXA Web Search Tool
features.description: In `src/tools/webSearchTools.ts`, implement the EXA search tool. This implementation should make calls to the EXA API to perform web searches based on a given query.

features.title: Implement Tavily Web Search Tool
features.description: In `src/tools/webSearchTools.ts`, implement the Tavily search tool. This implementation will use the Tavily API to perform web searches.

features.title: Implement SerpAPI Web Search Tool
features.description: In `src/tools/webSearchTools.ts`, implement a search tool using SerpAPI to provide access to major search engines like Google or Bing.

features.title: Integrate Web Search Tools into Core Toolset
features.description: Modify `src/tools/tools.ts` to import and call `createWebSearchTools`. The new search functions should be merged into the main composed tools object to make them available to other parts of the system.

features.title: Expose Web Search Tools via Chat
features.description: Modify `src/tools/chatTools.ts` to add a new chat-callable tool, `webSearch`. This tool should accept a `query` and an optional `provider` argument (e.g., 'exa', 'tavily', 'serpapi') to dispatch the call to the correct implementation.

features.title: Update README.md with Web Search Tool Documentation
features.description: Update the main `README.md` file to add a section documenting the new web search functionality. This should include the list of available providers and instructions on how to configure the necessary API keys via environment variables.
